title: Implement real headed/headless switching in SessionManager
description: Current setHeadedMode is a stub. Implement browser relaunch logic to switch between headed and headless modes while preserving session state (cookies, localStorage) via the persistent profile.
acceptance_criteria: Calling talox.setHeaded(true) closes the current headless browser and launches a headed one.
The new browser instance preserves the current URL and session state (login remains active).
TaloxController methods (click, type, etc.) continue to work after the switch.
Emits 'headedEscalation' or 'headlessRestored' events upon successful switch.

title: Align Takeover Overlay visuals with v2 Specification
description: Update TakeoverBridge overlay to switch the glow color to amber (#ffaa00) when human takeover is active, and ensure the 'Resume Agent' button matches the spec design.
acceptance_criteria: Glow color is cyan (#00d4ff) while agent is running.
Glow color switches to amber (#ffaa00) when requestHumanTakeover is called.
Button label switches between '⏸ Take Over' and '▶ Resume Agent' correctly.
Button shows a countdown if humanTakeoverTimeoutMs > 0 is configured.

title: Implement Verbosity Level 3 (Full Tracing & AX-Tree Diffs)
description: Expand the verbosity system to support Level 3. This should enable Playwright's built-in tracing and generate full AX-tree structural diffs on every state change.
acceptance_criteria: If verbosity is set to 3, talox.stop() saves a Playwright trace file to the output directory.
Every navigate/click/type action generates a full AX-tree diff event when verbosity is 3.
Performance overhead is only incurred when level 3 is explicitly active.

title: Verify HumanMouse interaction timing baseline
description: Create a performance validation test to ensure that HumanMouse interactions are significantly slower than raw Playwright interactions, verifying that stealth timing is active.
acceptance_criteria: A test script compares the time taken for 10 clicks using HumanMouse vs. raw page.click().
HumanMouse interactions consistently show variable, human-like delays (>100ms per step).
Test passes in CI environment to prevent stealth regressions.

title: Integrate BotDetector signals into AdaptationEngine escalation
description: Ensure that specific bot-detection signals (like Cloudflare challenges or CAPTCHAs) correctly trigger the 'blocker_unresolvable_headless' reason to fire the headed escalation strategy.
acceptance_criteria: BotDetector identifies 'Cloudflare' or 'CAPTCHA' presence in the page state.
AdaptationEngine receives these signals and applies the 'escalate_to_headed' strategy.
The system successfully auto-relaunches the browser in headed mode when a block is detected.
